listing.name: Sonic R / Sonic R Android (ZinexDa)
listing.summary: Explore Sonic R / Sonic R Android (ZinexDa) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Finish setup in the upstream Android app
steps.instruction: Install this fork’s Android APK and use its guided asset installer to choose your own complete retail Sonic R PC game folder. This is the Android GLES2/SDL2 wrapper; a Windows player or another Sonic game’s files do not replace the required retail data. Choose Play through the upstream app after it accepts the folder.

steps.title: Keep your data when changing versions
steps.instruction: Keep your original game files and preserve the Android app’s actual save/config data before changing or removing it. The selected guide does not establish the exact save/export location. Multiplayer is a planned feature, not a delivered cross-platform promise. The upstream custom license permits free download/build/modification and forbids sale; this route retains those terms and upstream update ownership. Portcove does not manage APK replacement or its data backup.
